units.source_text: 红叶馆续弈的次日，本应从上午十点继续对弈，岂料一早就发生了一场争执，以致拖延到下午两点。

en.t: On the day after play resumed at the Momiji-kan, the match was supposed to continue from ten in the morning, but unexpectedly an argument broke out early, delaying it until two in the afternoon.

units.source_text: 我作为观战记者，是个旁观者，事情与我无关。

en.t: As the reporter covering the match, I was merely an observer, and the matter had nothing to do with me.

units.source_text: 我看见工作人员狼狈周章，日本棋院的棋手们也跑来了，好像是在另一房间里开会。

en.t: I saw the staff flustered and rushing about, and players from the Nihon Ki-in also came running over, apparently holding a meeting in another room.
